title: Magnet Release
body:
Magnet Release forms from Earth + Wind. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Iron Sand Volley (help iron sand volley)
Level 45: Magnetic Bind (help magnetic bind)
Level 70: Iron Sand Maelstrom (help iron sand maelstrom)
